title: Scoring-Rule Sensitivity in LLM Evaluation: Evidence from Indian Financial Regulatory Text
abstract: arXiv:2604.19298v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A benchmark leaderboard reports one accuracy number, but that number is a joint product of a model and a scoring rule. We ask what changes when only the rule changes, and find that model ordering is highly sensitive to it. IndiaFinBench is a 406-item expert-annotated benchmark over SEBI and RBI regulatory text covering regulatory interpretation, numerical reasoning, contradiction detection, and temporal reasoning. We score twelve LLMs zero-shot under two primary regimes over the same predictions - strict four-stage string matching, and the verdicts of a cross-model judge sharing no model family with any evaluated system - plus one operational composite regime. The two primary regimes show no positive rank correspondence (Spearman rho = -0.273, p = 0.39, not significant), and no model holds its rank across all three regimes. translated_title: 评分规则对大语言模型评估的敏感性：来自印度金融监管文本的证据
translated_abstract: 一项基准排行榜报告的是单一的准确率数字，但这个数字是模型与评分规则的共同产物。我们探究当仅改变评分规则时会发生什么，并发现模型的排名对评分规则高度敏感。IndiaFinBench 是一个包含406个条目、由专家标注的基准，基于SEBI（印度证券交易委员会）和RBI（印度储备银行）的监管文本，涵盖监管解读、数值推理、矛盾检测和时间推理。我们在两种主要评分机制下对十二个大语言模型进行零样本评分——严格的四阶段字符串匹配，以及与任何被评估系统无共享模型家族的跨模型裁判——外加一种操作性复合机制。两种主要机制之间没有正向的排名对应关系（Spearman rho = -0.273，p = 0.39，不显著），且没有任何模型能在所有三种机制下保持其排名。严格准确率范围为75.12%–89.66%；仅裁判评分的准确率范围为87.19%–94.83%，且出现了不同的领先者
tldr: 该研究构建了基于印度SEBI和RBI监管文本的专家标注基准IndiaFinBench，发现大语言模型的排名对评分规则高度敏感——严格字符串匹配与跨模型裁判两种评分机制之间甚至无显著的正向排名相关性——表明单一准确率数字是模型与评分规则的共同产物，不能可靠反映模型真实能力。
en_tdlr: Using the 406-item expert-annotated IndiaFinBench benchmark over SEBI and RBI regulatory text, this study shows that LLM rankings are highly sensitive to the scoring rule—with no significant positive rank correlation between strict string matching and a cross-model judge—demonstrating that a single accuracy number is a joint product of the model and the scoring rule rather than a reliable measure of model capability.
